description_en: Creates an AI model provider under a specified AgentTeams instance. You must specify the provider name, address, supported protocol list, and API keys
description_zh: 用于在指定 AgentTeams 实例下创建 AI 模型供应商，需指定供应商名称、地址、支持的协议列表及 API 密钥
kebab_example: aliyun agentteams create-model-provider --name AgentTeams --provider RUNNING --address https://api.example.com --protocols openai --api-keys sk-xxx --instance-id i-xxx --description my_provider --client-token ct-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateModelProvider

parameters.help_en: Optional. The instance name for fuzzy matching
parameters.help_zh: 可选，按实例名称模糊匹配
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: Optional. The instance status for exact matching
parameters.help_zh: 可选，实例状态精确匹配
parameters.name: provider

parameters.help_en: The address of the model provider
parameters.name: address

parameters.help_en: The list of protocols supported by the model provider, in JSON format
parameters.help_zh: 模型供应商支持的协议列表，JSON 格式
parameters.name: protocols

parameters.help_en: The list of API keys for the model provider, in JSON format
parameters.help_zh: 模型供应商的 API 密钥列表，JSON 格式
parameters.name: api_keys

parameters.help_en: The description of the model provider
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token that ensures the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 幂等令牌，用于保证请求幂等性
parameters.name: client_token
